# @llazyemail/template-runtime-display

> Stateless runtime that renders a whole HTML email from named parts and reports the part that broke. Ships an HTML inspector and a `template-runtime-display` CLI (`dev`, `inspect`). No runtime dependencies. Node 24+. Named exports only. No template registry.

- Repo: https://github.com/LLazyEmail/template-runtime-display
- Registry: https://npm.pkg.github.com (scope `@llazyemail`)
- README: https://github.com/LLazyEmail/template-runtime-display/blob/main/README.md
- Agent guide: https://github.com/LLazyEmail/template-runtime-display/blob/main/AGENTS.md
- Full API: https://github.com/LLazyEmail/template-runtime-display/blob/main/llms-full.txt
- Sample: https://github.com/LLazyEmail/template-runtime-display/blob/main/examples/compose.ts

## Render

```ts
import { explain, renderEmail, slot } from '@llazyemail/template-runtime-display';

const result = renderEmail(
  {
    id: 'weekly',
    parts: [{ id: 'note', render: (ctx) => slot(ctx, 'note') }],
  },
  {
    title: 'Weekly update',
    preview: 'Three things that shipped',
    heading: 'Weekly update',
    bodyText: 'Three things that shipped.',
    ctaLabel: 'Read',
    ctaUrl: 'https://example.com/update',
    companyName: 'LLazyEmail',
    unsubscribeUrl: 'https://example.com/unsubscribe',
  },
  { onError: 'collect', slots: { note: '<p>Custom note</p>' } },
);

explain(result);
result.html;
```

`renderTemplate` and `defineTemplate` are the same runtime without the email shell. `renderMany`, `RenderJob`, `RenderOptions`, and `RenderError` are re-exported from `@llazyemail/render-template`. `renderMany` batches jobs that share one props type. Default `onError` is `throw` (`RenderError` with `partId`, `trace`, and `cause`). `collect` keeps going and sets `ok: false`.

Fragment helpers `head`, `main`, `footer`, `body`, `content`, and `document` return strings. Omitted strings are empty. The button needs both `ctaLabel` and `ctaUrl`. Unsubscribe needs `unsubscribeUrl`. Props and slots are raw HTML. `document` uses `<html lang="en">`.

## Inspect

```ts
import { diffRenders, formatDiff, inspect } from '@llazyemail/template-runtime-display';

inspect(result, { title: 'optional', compareTo: earlierResult }); // string: self-contained HTML page
formatDiff(diffRenders(before, after)); // string for a terminal
```

`inspect` accepts a `RenderResult` or a thrown `RenderError`. The page has no scripts or network requests, and part HTML appears only in `sandbox=""` frames and escaped blocks.

```bash
template-runtime-display dev ./letter.mjs [--port 4177] [--host 127.0.0.1] [--watch dir]
template-runtime-display inspect ./letter.mjs [--out inspect.html]   # exit 0 ok, 1 part broke, 2 could not render
```

The module exports `template`, and optionally `props` and `options`. The CLI defaults `onError` to `collect`.

## Quality checks

```ts
import { measureSize, toText } from '@llazyemail/template-runtime-display/quality';
import { traceJson } from '@llazyemail/template-runtime-display';

measureSize(result); // { bytes, clipRisk: 'ok' | 'near' | 'over', perPart, clippedParts, unsubscribeClipped, warnings }
toText(result.html); // plain-text alternative, wrapped at 78 columns
traceJson(result); // status, bytes and ms per part, errors, size check
```

`bytes` is UTF-8, which is what Gmail counts against its ~102 KB clip. `inspect --json trace.json` writes the trace, and the dev server serves it at `/trace.json`. The report shows size, the plain-text version, and a Light / Dark preview. Guide: docs/inspector.md.
